text:
maria: Heads up — observed sidepanel 'Graph' card showing rows from another org after rapid org-switch. Repro steps below. @eng-platform please triage :eyes:

maria: Repro steps:
```
1) Login as alice@acme (org=acme)
2) Open dashboard X -> sidepanel Graph card
3) Cmd-K quick switch to bob@stark (org=stark)
4) Navigate back to same dashboard -> Graph still shows acme rows
```

tom: I can repro locally, the card's prefetch call returns cached payload with no workspace header when quickswitch used.

sasha: Sounds like the cache key for the widget omits workspace/org id. We recently moved to route-id-only cache keys to reduce cardinality.

ana: (typo) ana: telemetry shows spike in `sidepanel_render_mismatch` metric around 2024-11-10T14:12Z, tag `org_mismatch=true`.

kevin: This might be related to the rollout where we enabled `quickswitch-preview` for 30% — the rollout policy uses route affinity but not org scoping. Rolling back the flag for now? :warning:

deploy-bot: deploy:console/sidepanel-cache-fix v2024.11.10 started by kevin — canary -> 5%

tom: Quick triage idea: update `getScopedCacheKey(route, ctx)` to include ctx.workspace_id and prefix with widget version. Sending a PR with test.

maria: Assign to tom. Also add a safety: if cached payload.workspace_id != request.workspace_id then invalidate and fetch fresh. Fail closed (don't render) rather than show wrong org data.

sasha: Also need to change metrics aggregation — the metrics pipeline aggregates by route_id only, which collapses org dimension. I'll open a ticket to emit `workspace_id` tag and change rollup keys.

ana: ana: created INFR-3241 to add `workspace_id` tag to sidepanel telemetry and to alert when org_mismatch > 0.1%.

kevin: Good. Also add a canary check: when quickswitch is used, double-check response.workspace_id in the client before hydrating widgets. If mismatch, show spinner and refetch.

maria: Agreed. Prioritize hotfix for prod and roll back the rollout for quickswitch-preview until tests pass.

tom: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/8321 — adds ctx.workspace_id to cache key, adds unit + e2e test for rapid org switch.

maria: Reviewing now. Will request changes if any.

sasha: Follow-up: need to check internal API too — `GET /internal/widget/prefetch` currently ignores X-Workspace header and uses token org. That mismatch can cause prefetch to return other orgs when tokens are shared.

ana: ana: I'll audit internal endpoints and add tests for header precedence.

maria: Thanks. After patch merges, coordinate a canary and monitor `org_mismatch` metric and support inbox. If we see >50 incidents, trigger incident.

kevin: One last note — let's add a small e2e that simulates two users rapidly switching workspaces and asserts no cross-org leakage. Avoid flakiness by running only in CI cluster with deterministic timing.

maria: Sounds good. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
